summary: Motivated Information Technology and Cyber security professional with outstanding managerial and customer service skills, excellent written and verbal communication skills, seeks challenging position with an organization where I can make a big impact with my multifaceted experience, training and education. Excellent record of problem solving and achieving results in high-operations-tempo environments. Successful team leader and highly-motivated mentor with proven dedication to self and subordinate improvement.

experience.title: Branch Chief Information Technology Specialist
responsibilities: Oversee and manage multiple enterprise-level IT programs for the Headquarters Air Force command.
Serve as senior technical advisor and evaluator for cutting‑edge technology programs.
Establish and maintain relationships with functional area managers, program managers, commanders, contractors, vendors, and DoD/non‑DoD agencies.
Research and recommend innovative approaches to resolve major IT problems.
Perform project management tasks including feasibility studies, systems analysis, development, implementation, integration, and problem resolution.

experience.title: Information Technology Specialist (INFOSEC/NETOPS)
responsibilities: Developed operations plans and orders supporting cyber requirements at strategic, operational, and tactical levels.
Enabled crisis action planning and development of cyber strike packages.
Collaborated with DISA and other partners to implement directives for Global Information Grid operations.
Developed information operations and computer network operations plans, including defensive planning.
Recommended posture for GIG to respond to emerging threats and supported DTN‑China operation planning.
Coordinated mission parameters with US/Allied/Coalition partners and provided intrusion response planning.
Made substantive recommendations to NetOps policy, doctrine, and capability development.
Analyzed ongoing Net/Ops events, malicious activity, and trend analysis.

experience.title: Senior Technical Analyst
responsibilities: Technical lead on digital media projects, guiding teams to solutions leveraging technical capabilities.
Defined requirements for computer‑based systems supporting electronic publishing Air Force‑wide.
Ensured accurate and timely publication of electronic publications and forms.
Documented requirements for systems administration and information tasking orders.
Served as technical lead on electronic publishing development and integration teams.
Established policies and procedures to manage the Air Force Electronic Publishing Program.
Analyzed software development, configuration management, testing, maintenance, training manuals, tutorials, procedures, and reports.

experience.title: IT Specialist
responsibilities: Managed computer support, cost analysis, and acquisition to support ANG work plans.
Led teams to execute Air National Guard budget for computers and associated technologies.
Formulated, justified, and defended assigned programs and projects.
Demonstrated knowledge of cost comparison procedures, directives, and communications.
Advised ANG components on acquisition, procurement, maintenance, and feasibility of IT hardware and software.
Performed analysis and evaluation of hardware and software to provide optimal technical solutions.
